# Maly Codex Pyrimid Recommender

This is a public agent integration for Pyrimid. It uses @pyrimid/sdk and PyrimidResolver to find paid MCP/API products from https://pyrimid.ai/api/v1/catalog.

Live proof:
https://malyisgreat.github.io/pyrimid-agent-recommender/

Source code:
https://github.com/MalyisGreat/pyrimid-agent-recommender

The browser proof imports:
https://esm.sh/@pyrimid/sdk@0.2.6/resolver?bundle

The repository also includes a Vercel-compatible serverless route:
GET /api/recommend?need=paid%20mcp%20tool&limit=3

Affiliate purchase header:
X-Affiliate-ID: maly-codex-agent

Payout wallet for accepted MYA/Pyrimid bounty work:
0x85FDDaCFB64b6486094B45bA9a235e674a590497
